title: Elective Affinities
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This volume explores the historical, socio-political, transcultural, and intertextual connections between East Central Europe and Latin America from the nineteenth century to the present. The contributions from different disciplines open up inspiring perspectives for the study of international literary and cultural networks in the (post-)globalized world, and shed new light on the history of world literature.
